parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 100 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 100 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 100 family inet address 10.0.0.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 100 family.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.1/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-instances vrf1 instance-type.explanation: 配置路由实例的类型为虚拟路由器。

set routing-instances vrf1 route-disting.explanation: 配置路由实例的路由区分器。

parameters.name: route-distinguisher
parameters.explanation: 路由区分器，用于区分不同路由实例的路由。

set routing-instances vrf1 interface lo0.explanation: 将接口绑定到路由实例。

set routing-instances vrf1 routing-optio.template: set routing-instances [parameter1] routing-options static route [parameter2]/[parameter3] next-hop [parameter4]
set routing-instances vrf1 routing-optio.command: set routing-instances vrf1 routing-options static route 3.3.3.3/32 next-hop 10.0.0.2
set routing-instances vrf1 routing-optio.explanation: 配置路由实例的静态路由。

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: 静态路由的子网掩码位数。

parameters.name: next-hop
parameters.explanation: 静态路由的下一跳地址。
